resourceStatusAllBlock.title: Resource Status All 1
resourceStatusAllBlock.description: Summarize the total resource inventory with a circular status distribution, detailed counts, and determinate-state coverage.
resourceStatusAllBlock.guidanceBody: Replace defaultResourceStatuses or provide statuses and total from your inventory model. The donut, four-state summary, and coverage line are calculated from the same values; mark a status countsTowardCoverage: false when it is not determinable.
